title: ATCMH derived airport geometry
transformation: Local XML/CSV importer selects aeroway features, retains OSM way IDs, projects latitude/longitude to nautical miles east/north of the airport origin and rounds coordinates to 5 decimal places. Import date and origin are in the downloaded data. New snapshots include all open OurAirports runway pairs with L/R/C identifiers and true headings. Closed runways are omitted. OSM map tiles are merged by element ID; incomplete extracts are rejected. Oriented parking-position ways are retained for ground spawning. SHA-256 source hashes and a content version are recorded. MHz values are not inferred from map data. Runway axis corrections dated 2026-10-25 retain mapped surface features and original source hashes. ROAH uses the pinned Infinite Flight navigation endpoint coordinates; other corrected axes use joined OSM centerlines. Archived geometry versions remain available to saved exercises.

inferredApronConnectors.note: 28 estimated straight extensions from mapped stand centerlines to adjacent mapped taxiways, each under 25 m. Names and approximate terminal/apron areas are shown in the 2024 simulation briefing; connector geometry is inferred, not independently mapped or surveyed. Eleven terminal gate nodes were separately checked within 34 m of the mapped parking endpoints; these nodes identify terminal gates, not aircraft stop coordinates.

sources.groundStands: 23 OpenStreetMap parking-position lines; terminal extract sha256 45e4d76bee6de2921f10362dece9d2401953b43f084f48258b730f292f969621; direction confirmed by matching named mapped parking nodes, names and approximate terminal areas compared with the Lido stand table effective 5 October 2023 https://randomflightdatabase.fr/cartes/Lido1/CYYC.pdf (coordinates rounded to 0.1 minute). Additional stands await verification.

terminalStandOrientation.note: Ten parking lines reversed toward their correspondingly named mapped terminal gates; this verifies orientation by proximity, not exact aircraft stop coordinates.
